parameter-group.name: cardata
parameter-group.label: CarData
parameter-group.description: Client registration in the MyBMW / CarData customer portal

parameter-group.name: broker
parameter-group.label: Stream Broker
parameter-group.description: Local MQTT broker the bmw-mqtt-bridge republishes the CarData stream to

parameter-group.name: rest
parameter-group.label: REST Requests
parameter-group.description: BMW allows 50 REST requests per account per day

parameter.name: clientId
parameter.label: Client ID
parameter.description: CarData client ID generated in the customer portal, subscribed to both CarData API and CarData Stream

parameter.name: brokerHost
parameter.label: Broker Host
parameter.description: Host name or IP address of the broker the bridge publishes to

parameter.name: topicPrefix
parameter.label: Topic Prefix
parameter.description: The LOCAL_PREFIX configured in the bridge

parameter.name: refreshInterval
parameter.label: Refresh Interval
parameter.description: Hours between REST refreshes of all vehicle values, one request per vehicle. 0 disables the periodic refresh; values are still fetched at startup and after stream outages.

parameter.name: requestBudget
parameter.label: Request Budget
parameter.description: Maximum number of REST requests the binding sends in 24 hours. Keep it below BMW's limit of 50 if other tools use the same account.
